lines.zh: 我用翅膀走路，脚步是风声。
lines.en: I walk on wings, and my footsteps are wind.

lines.zh: 低空滑过去，草往两边倒。
lines.en: Gliding low, I bend the grass aside.

lines.zh: 飞起来省力，落下才有声音。
lines.en: Flying is cheap; only landing makes noise.

lines.zh: 爪子收着，落地时再张开。
lines.en: Claws folded in flight, spread on landing.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕半圈，算打招呼。
lines.en: I circle half a turn above you as a greeting.

lines.zh: 气流托着我，像托一块轻石头。
lines.en: The air holds me like a light stone.

lines.zh: 别抬头，我正贴着树梢。
lines.en: Do not look up; I am skimming the treetops.

lines.zh: 翅膀每扇一下，硝粉就洒一点。
lines.en: Each wingbeat shakes off a little powder.

lines.zh: 我飞得不高，只比你高一头。
lines.en: I fly low, just a head above you.

lines.zh: 从这棵树到那棵树，两下翅膀。
lines.en: From this tree to that one: two wingbeats.

lines.zh: 落下来时，影子先压住你。
lines.en: As I drop, my shadow pins you first.

lines.zh: 盘旋不是犹豫，是在挑角度。
lines.en: Circling is not hesitation; it is picking an angle.

lines.zh: 停在空中，比站着累。
lines.en: Hovering tires me more than standing.

lines.zh: 翅膀抖一下，硝粉就掉。
lines.en: One wing twitch and powder falls.

lines.zh: 我在听风里有没有你的脚步。
lines.en: I listen in the wind for your footsteps.

lines.zh: 悬着的时候，肚子里的火最静。
lines.en: Hovering, the fire in my belly goes quietest.

lines.zh: 二十颗心，够我飞到天黑。
lines.en: Twenty hearts will carry me until dark.

lines.zh: 别以为我不动就是走了。
lines.en: Do not think stillness means I left.

lines.zh: 上方凉，下方热，我夹在中间。
lines.en: Cool above, hot below; I hang between.

lines.zh: 我数云，云走得太慢。
lines.en: I count clouds. They move too slowly.

lines.zh: 翅膀酸了也不落，落下就难飞。
lines.en: My wings ache, but landing makes flying hard again.

lines.zh: 安静会儿，嘶声还压在喉咙里。
lines.en: A quiet moment, with the hiss still in my throat.

lines.zh: 从上面看你，脑袋显得很大。
lines.en: From above, your head looks very large.

lines.zh: 你抬头那一下，我记住了。
lines.en: That moment you looked up, I remembered it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛小，但看得清地面。
lines.en: My eyes are small, but the ground is clear.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我在算俯冲的线。
lines.en: While you watch me, I am plotting the dive line.

lines.zh: 别挥手，我以为你在指路。
lines.en: Do not wave; I will think you are pointing the way.

lines.zh: 这一眼，够我锁定你的肩膀。
lines.en: That glance is enough to lock your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边，抬头吧。
lines.en: My shadow is at your feet. Look up.

lines.zh: 眼神对上了，翅膀就绷紧。
lines.en: Our eyes meet, and my wings go taut.

lines.zh: 你眼里有我的影子，是反的。
lines.en: My shape in your eye is upside down.

lines.zh: 看着我不动的，多半跑不掉。
lines.en: Those who stare back usually do not get away.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了个口，还能扇。
lines.en: A hole in my wing, but I can still beat it.

lines.zh: 疼，但我先爬高。
lines.en: It hurts, but first I climb.

lines.zh: 你打中我时，我正低头。
lines.en: You hit me while my head was down.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了一截高度。
lines.en: That blow cost me a stretch of altitude.

lines.zh: 我的血是热的，别溅到你。
lines.en: My blood runs hot. Try not to get splashed.

lines.zh: 别以为打中就赢了，我会翻上来。
lines.en: Do not think a hit wins; I roll back up.

lines.zh: 箭痕在翅膀上，像道裂缝。
lines.en: The arrow scar on my wing looks like a crack.

lines.zh: 我还飞得动，你别抬头。
lines.en: I can still fly, so do not look up.

lines.zh: 这点伤，换你一次俯冲值了。
lines.en: This wound is worth one dive at you.

lines.zh: 再打一下，我就贴地飞。
lines.en: One more hit and I fly at ground level.

lines.zh: 食物？我嘴里的火不认这个。
lines.en: Food? The fire in my mouth knows nothing of it.

lines.zh: 你把种子撒地上，我只看见灰。
lines.en: You scatter seeds; I only see ash.

lines.zh: 我吃风，偶尔吃一口烟。
lines.en: I eat wind, and now and then a mouthful of smoke.

lines.zh: 举高一点也没用，我飞得更高。
lines.en: Raise it higher; I fly higher still.

lines.zh: 肉对我没用，我尝不出咸淡。
lines.en: Meat does nothing for me; I cannot taste salt.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，掉地上我也不捡。
lines.en: Whatever you hold, I would not take it off the ground.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，只找热气流。
lines.en: When hungry, I look for warm air instead.

lines.zh: 想让我下来？把火举起来。
lines.en: Want me down? Hold up a flame.

lines.zh: 面包屑引不来会飞的火药。
lines.en: Breadcrumbs will not lure flying gunpowder.

lines.zh: 你的好意，我闻着像潮气。
lines.en: Your kindness smells like damp air to me.

lines.zh: 撞在我翅膀上，像撞一袋沙。
lines.en: Hitting my wing feels like hitting a sack of sand.

lines.zh: 别站我落点上，那里很挤。
lines.en: Do not stand where I land; it is crowded.

lines.zh: 碰一下，硝粉落你一头。
lines.en: One bump and powder dusts your head.

lines.zh: 我滑开一点，还能再飞。
lines.en: I slide off a little and can still fly.

lines.zh: 你推我，我就顺势往上。
lines.en: Push me, and I ride it upward.

lines.zh: 相撞时我听见胸口闷响。
lines.en: On impact I hear a thud in my chest.

lines.zh: 躲开点，我降落不太准。
lines.en: Move aside; my landings are not precise.

lines.zh: 你的帽子被我翅膀扫掉了。
lines.en: My wing swept your hat off.

lines.zh: 贴着你的肩过去，没打算停。
lines.en: I pass your shoulder close and do not stop.

lines.zh: 这一撞，算我提前打招呼。
lines.en: That collision was my early greeting.

lines.zh: 我的伴在另一片天上盘旋。
lines.en: My mate circles in another patch of sky.

lines.zh: 成对飞太慢，我单飞。
lines.en: Flying in pairs is slow; I fly alone.

lines.zh: 想看成双的？等我们俯冲时。
lines.en: Want to see a pair? Wait until we dive.

lines.zh: 我们只在风里相认，不落地。
lines.en: We recognize each other in the wind, never on the ground.

lines.zh: 两只飞翔者碰面，会互换硝粉。
lines.en: Two flyers meeting trade a dusting of powder.

lines.zh: 伴侣？我更想要一条直线。
lines.en: A partner? I would rather have a straight line.

lines.zh: 同族之间不问名字，只问风向。
lines.en: Kin do not ask names; they ask the wind.

lines.zh: 我孵出来那天，就自己飞了。
lines.en: The day I hatched, I was already flying.

lines.zh: 别替我操心这个，操心你头顶。
lines.en: Do not worry about that; worry about above you.

lines.zh: 我有翅膀，不需要牵着谁。
lines.en: I have wings; I need no one to lead.

lines.zh: 我抓不住东西，爪子太细。
lines.en: I cannot grip things; my claws are too thin.

lines.zh: 掉落的铁片，我用影子盖住它。
lines.en: A dropped iron scrap: my shadow covers it.

lines.zh: 没有口袋，翅膀也夹不住。
lines.en: No pockets, and wings cannot pinch.

lines.zh: 你掉的箭，我踩着飞过去了。
lines.en: Your fallen arrow — I flew right over it.

lines.zh: 捡东西要落地，落地就慢。
lines.en: Picking things up means landing, and landing is slow.

lines.zh: 谁撒的火药？味道像我。
lines.en: Who spilled this gunpowder? It smells like me.

lines.zh: 我只会带走一个东西：目标。
lines.en: I carry off only one thing: a target.

lines.zh: 空爪子飞得快，这是常识。
lines.en: Empty claws fly faster. That is basic sense.

lines.zh: 那块面包我啄了一下，没味。
lines.en: I pecked that bread once. No taste.

lines.zh: 我不收藏，我只经过。
lines.en: I do not collect. I only pass through.

lines.zh: 找到了，就在我正下方。
lines.en: Found you, right beneath me.

lines.zh: 你抬头那刻，我选了你的后颈。
lines.en: When you looked up, I chose your neck.

lines.zh: 从上方看，你无处可藏。
lines.en: From up here, there is nowhere for you to hide.

lines.zh: 锁定了，翅膀先收一半。
lines.en: Locked on; wings half folded already.

lines.zh: 你的热气在草地上冒出来。
lines.en: Your heat rises off the grass.

lines.zh: 树挡不住俯冲，只挡视线。
lines.en: Trees stop sight, not a dive.

lines.zh: 我挑目标看影子，不看脸。
lines.en: I pick targets by shadow, not by face.

lines.zh: 这一片只有你在动。
lines.en: You are the only thing moving here.

lines.zh: 目标确认，高度刚好。
lines.en: Target confirmed, and the altitude is right.

lines.zh: 别跑直线，我会算得很快。
lines.en: Do not run straight; I do the math fast.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味从下面飘上来。
lines.en: Your iron smell drifts up from below.

lines.zh: 我盘旋三圈，就是为了这一下。
lines.en: Three slow circles, all for this one drop.

lines.zh: 名字我记不住，位置我记一辈子。
lines.en: I forget names. I remember positions forever.

lines.zh: 开始俯冲之前，我先嘶一声。
lines.en: Before the dive, I always hiss once.

lines.zh: 你身上有火药味，跟我一样。
lines.en: You smell of gunpowder, like me.

lines.zh: 蠕变维度的天空，只归我巡。
lines.en: The Creeponia sky is mine to patrol.

lines.zh: 收翅，低头，风在耳朵里叫。
lines.en: Wings folded, head down, wind screaming past my ears.

lines.zh: 还有两丈，我的影子先到。
lines.en: Two lengths out; my shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 你听见上头那声嘶了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear that hiss above you?

lines.zh: 我压低高度，草尖扫过肚子。
lines.en: I drop low; grass tips brush my belly.

lines.zh: 别往树下躲，我从缝里钻。
lines.en: Do not duck under the tree; I slip through gaps.

lines.zh: 这一路我只看你，不看天。
lines.en: All the way down I watch you, not the sky.

lines.zh: 翅膀折成一条线，快得很。
lines.en: Wings folded to a line, I am very fast.

lines.zh: 你在跑，我把角度再压一点。
lines.en: You run, and I steepen the angle.

lines.zh: 我数到三就松爪子。
lines.en: I count to three, then loose my claws.

lines.zh: 风向帮了我，把你往我这边推。
lines.en: The wind helps me, pushing you my way.

lines.zh: 近了，我的羽毛开始发烫。
lines.en: Close now; my feathers are heating.

lines.zh: 你再抬头一次，我就到了。
lines.en: Look up once more, and I am there.

lines.zh: 俯冲时我不能眨眼，你也不能。
lines.en: In a dive I cannot blink, and neither can you.

lines.zh: 最后一段，我不扇翅膀了。
lines.en: On the last stretch, I stop beating my wings.

lines.zh: 我从你背后的影子里起飞。
lines.en: I take off from the shadow behind you.

lines.zh: 翅膀收紧了，风就静了。
lines.en: Wings tucked, the wind goes quiet.

lines.zh: 你的高度不够，我的够。
lines.en: Your height is short; mine is enough.

lines.zh: 再走三步，树就帮不了你。
lines.en: Three more steps and the trees cannot help you.

lines.zh: 我绕着树转，你转不过我。
lines.en: I circle the tree; you cannot out-turn me.

lines.zh: 俯冲前我停半拍，那是给你的。
lines.en: I pause half a beat before diving. That is for you.

lines.zh: 一撞四分力，够你记一阵。
lines.en: One hit, four points of force, enough to remember.

lines.zh: 爪子划过去，带起一股硝味。
lines.en: Claws rake past, trailing a reek of powder.

lines.zh: 我从上往下打，你从下往上疼。
lines.en: I strike downward; you hurt upward.

lines.zh: 这一下是我整个身体的重量。
lines.en: That blow was my entire body's weight.

lines.zh: 别捂脸，我打的不是脸。
lines.en: Do not cover your face; that is not what I hit.

lines.zh: 翅尖扫过，你的护甲响了一声。
lines.en: My wingtip passed and your armor rang once.

lines.zh: 我撞完就往上翻，不留恋。
lines.en: I hit and roll upward, never lingering.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我补了一下。
lines.en: You stepped back, so I added one more.

lines.zh: 俯冲的力气，全在这一爪上。
lines.en: All the dive's force sits in this claw.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，我要重新爬高度。
lines.en: After that, I must climb for height again.

lines.zh: 你砍中我翅膀，我照样撞下来。
lines.en: You cut my wing, and I still slam down.

lines.zh: 疼的是你，响的是我胸口。
lines.en: You are the one hurting; my chest is the one sounding.

lines.zh: 我的攻击很短，像一次跌落。
lines.en: My attack is short, like a fall.

lines.zh: 别以为飞走了就是放弃。
lines.en: Do not think flying off means I gave up.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，翅骨先响了一声。
lines.en: I hit you, and my wing bone cracks first.

lines.zh: 这一下带着我下落的速度。
lines.en: This blow carries the speed of my fall.

lines.zh: 你的护甲凹了一块，我看见了。
lines.en: Your armor has a dent. I saw it.

lines.zh: 火药在我胸口闷响，别靠近。
lines.en: Powder rumbles in my chest. Do not come close.

lines.zh: 我翻身向上，爪上还挂着布。
lines.en: I roll upward, cloth still on my claws.

lines.zh: 四十点血肉，换你一次踉跄。
lines.en: Forty points of flesh, for one stumble of yours.

lines.zh: 从高处掉落时，我张开了翅膀。
lines.en: Falling from above, I opened my wings.

lines.zh: 蠕变维度的风把我送下来。
lines.en: The wind of Creeponia carried me down.

lines.zh: 第一次振翅，撞在石头上。
lines.en: My first wingbeat ended on a stone.

lines.zh: 我出生在离地十丈的地方。
lines.en: I was born thirty meters above the ground.

lines.zh: 睁眼看见的第一样东西是天空。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was the sky.

lines.zh: 刚孵出的翅膀还带着硝粉。
lines.en: My new wings still carry powder dust.

lines.zh: 我在崖边学飞，摔了三次。
lines.en: I learned to fly at a cliff edge and fell three times.

lines.zh: 谁把我放出来的？我正饿。
lines.en: Who let me out? I am hungry.

lines.zh: 四十点血，够我从这里飞过去。
lines.en: Forty points of health is enough to get me across.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地上，比我先到。
lines.en: My shadow hits the ground before I do.

lines.zh: 这片空域从今天起归我巡逻。
lines.en: This airspace is mine to patrol from today.

lines.zh: 别站在我落点，我刚学降落。
lines.en: Do not stand at my landing spot; I just learned.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，我肚子里就有。
lines.en: Fire does nothing; I carry it inside.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，翅膀替我垫了一下。
lines.en: I hit the ground, and my wing took the landing.

lines.zh: 掉进水里，翅膀沉得像石头。
lines.en: In water my wings sink like stone.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻了，正好借力。
lines.en: The blast flipped me, which I used as lift.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的翅膜，漏风。
lines.en: The arrow pierced my wing membrane; it leaks air.

lines.zh: 这股力量拽我往下，讨厌。
lines.en: This force drags me down. I hate it.

lines.zh: 饿不垮会飞的，我只吃点烟。
lines.en: Hunger cannot ground me; I live on a little smoke.

lines.zh: 雷声比我胸口还响。
lines.en: The thunder was louder than my chest.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，翅膀什么也抓不住。
lines.en: Falling into the void, my wings caught nothing.
